sections.heading: Six services, from the first drawing.
sections.text:
Six services, from the first drawing.
The full cycle, so one team answers for the facility working as intended.
1
Engineering design and consultation
Concept to detailed design, feasibility, permitting, BIM.
2
Procurement
Sourcing, tenders and long-lead equipment, tracked in one system.
3
Construction
Site management, safety, quality, programme and cost.
4
Testing and commissioning
Proven to operate as intended, before handover.
5
Tool Installation
Production tools connected into the facility and released to production.
6
Maintenance
Planned care that protects lifespan and uptime.
